items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I would listen to him on the truck advertising for a dance that night

ctx.x: He's one of my favorites. How about Buddy Petit? I never got to hear him at all.

Buddy Petit was very good too. I didn't hear him too very much, not as much as I had listened to Kid Renee or even Chris Kelly because Chris Kelly used to stay out of my neighborhood there. So I used to get a chance to listen to that in practice all the time. But I understand that I think Buddy Petit, he used to work at a little place on St. Bernard Street, he used to call it Alley. And he had worked there and of course that was out of my jurisdiction and I wasn't allowed to go that far. But the only experience I…
Do you remember much about Chris Kelly?
